system.description:
The perfected and final dance of the Kaguya clan. This dance is the most devastating and deadly as you focus and empower your bones before sending them through the ground around you, expanding them and having them rise like trees in a forest.

You fill a 45-foot radius, centered on you with these splintering bone towers that then splinter into branches of piercing ivory. Creatures in range other than you, must make a Dexterity saving throw.

On a failure, affected creatures take 10d8 piercing damage. If a creature that failed their saving throw has temporary hit points or DR granted as a result of a jutsu they cast, they reduce the temporary hit points or DR gained too before calculating the damage they take.

On a success, affected creatures take half as much damage and no further effects.

The bone forest remains permanently after casting this jutsu. The bone pillars are 10 to 15 feet tall and occupy a portion of each space in range. Creatures, excluding you that move within the affected area must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 feet traveled.

While inside this area, for the next minute after casting this jutsu, you can spend your reaction to cause the bone pillars to interpose damage you would take from another creature within the affected area. If a bone pillars hit points are reduced to 0 any remaining damage is applied to you. Bone pillars have 30 hit points.

Battle Lust: By spending 3 Battle Lust on your turn, while in this jutsu’s affected area, you can select a space within it to teleport to. When you do, creatures within 5 feet of the space you teleport to suffer a -2 penalty to saving throws made against a Hijutsu you cast before the end of the current turn.
